Position Summary
We are seeking a Senior Python Developer to join Veridian Systems, a fast-growing enterprise software company building scalable data processing and analytics platforms for financial services and retail clients. The Senior Python Developer will play a central role on a cross-functional engineering team responsible for designing, implementing, and operating API-driven backend services and data pipelines. This role requires hands-on development of high-performance Python services, strong experience with relational databases, API frameworks, and cloud-native deployment on AWS. The Senior Python Developer will mentor peers, contribute to architecture decisions, and help evolve our CI/CD and observability practices.

Key Responsibilities

Design and Architecture
- Collaborate with product management, data engineering, and platform teams to define service boundaries, APIs, and data models.
- Architect and implement scalable microservices and serverless components using Python, ensuring clear separation of concerns and maintainable code.
- Make pragmatic technology choices to meet performance, reliability, and cost objectives on AWS.

API and Service Development
- Develop and maintain high-throughput, low-latency REST and async APIs using FastAPI as the primary framework.
- Implement authentication, authorization, input validation, request/response schemas, and OpenAPI specifications for production APIs.
- Build and maintain reusable internal libraries and SDKs to accelerate service development across teams.

Data and Persistence
- Design efficient relational schemas and SQL for PostgreSQL to support OLTP and analytical workloads.
- Implement database migrations, connection pooling, indexing strategies, and query performance tuning.
- Work with data engineering to integrate streaming and batch data flows from upstream and downstream systems.

Cloud Operations and DevOps
- Deploy, operate, and troubleshoot services on AWS, leveraging managed services where appropriate.
- Implement Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and blue/green or canary deployment patterns.
- Instrument services with logging, metrics, and distributed tracing for production observability and incident response.

Performance, Reliability and Security
- Profile and optimize Python code paths for CPU, memory and I/O efficiency; implement caching strategies and async processing where beneficial.
- Drive SLO/SLI implementation, runload tests, and participate in post-incident reviews to improve system reliability.
- Collaborate with security engineers to ensure secure coding practices, dependency management, and vulnerability remediation.

Team Leadership and Mentoring
- Provide technical leadership and mentoring to mid-level and junior engineers; lead design reviews and code reviews.
- Contribute to engineering standards, best practices, and onboarding materials to raise team productivity.
- Represent the team in cross-functional planning, architecture boards, and customer-facing technical discussions when required.

Required Qualifications

Experience
- 6-10 years of professional software development experience, with a significant portion working on backend services and APIs.

Technical Skills (Mandatory)
- Python: Deep expertise in writing production-grade Python services, asynchronous programming, testing, and packaging.
- PostgreSQL: Strong experience designing schemas, writing performant SQL, tuning queries, and managing migrations.
- FastAPI: Proven experience building RESTful and async APIs using FastAPI, including schema validation and OpenAPI generation.
- AWS: Hands-on experience deploying and operating services on AWS, familiarity with EC2, ECS/EKS, Lambda, RDS, IAM, S3, CloudWatch, and related services.

Preferred Qualifications (Good-to-have)
- Flask: Experience building services with Flask, able to work across codebases that use different Python web frameworks.
- Redis: Experience using Redis for caching, pub/sub, and low-latency data structures to improve application performance.

Success Metrics
- API reliability: Achieve and maintain service availability targets (SLA/SLO) for core APIs with demonstrable reduction in incidents over time.
- Performance improvements: Deliver measurable latency and throughput improvements for critical endpoints (e.g., 30-50% reduction in median latency or significant increase in request capacity).
- Delivery cadence: Lead delivery of major features and infrastructure improvements on schedule with minimal production rollbacks.
- Code quality and team enablement: Increase unit/integration test coverage, reduce production bugs, and mentor peers resulting in faster onboarding and higher engineering throughput.
- Operational excellence: Implement robust observability and CI/CD practices that reduce mean time to detect and mean time to recover for production issues.

Location and Work Mode
- Hybrid: Bengaluru or Mumbai, 3 days a week in the office.
